title: 0. Executive Thesis, Dual Verdict & Opportunity Matrix
book_title: Prologue: The Business, The Price & Our Independent Verdict

epigraph.quote: Great compounding machines rarely look cheap in the rear-view mirror; they look reasonably priced only when you measure tomorrow's cash-flow power against today's capital buildout.
epigraph.author: Institutional Monograph Prologue

web_blocks.html: Eli Lilly and Company (NYSE: LLY) leads the world in incretin care with Mounjaro, Zepbound, and its new oral GLP-1 pill Foundayo. High-margin drugs in Oncology (Verzenio), Immunology (Taltz, Ebglyss), and Neuroscience (Kisunla) back up this core engine [2, 3, 8]. In FY2025, sales rose to $65,179 million, while operating profit hit $26,302 million (40.4% EBIT margin) and net income reached $20,640 million [3]. By Q3 2026, TTM sales climbed 45.5% YoY to $86.46 billion, with a 51.25% TTM operating margin and 31.61% ROIC. Management then raised FY2026 sales guidance to $91.0B–$92.0B and Non-GAAP EPS to $35.00–$36.00 [4].

web_blocks.html: Our view weighs both sides of the trade. The Bull case rests on +53% volume growth, over 500,000 Medicare GLP-1 Bridge scripts (~70% Lilly share), Foundayo's oral launch, and retatrutide's Q1 2027 BLA filing. The Bear case flags a -15% net price drop, over $50B in plant capex weighing on near-term FCF ($8.97B in FY25), and multiple compression risk if growth slows. At 26.75x Forward P/E and 0.79 PEG in a Stage 2 pullback (+6.70% above the 10W EMA on 0.95x volume), the odds favor staged buying.

Across all three time horizons, the plan stays clear and simple. Short-term traders get a low-volume pullback right near the 10-week EMA ($1,295.91). Medium-term buyers get Foundayo's launch ramp and retatrutide's Q1 2027 filing. Long-term owners get a 31.61% ROIC compounder with patents into the 2040s. Wait for pullback into $1,283.94–$1,323.04 support zone (2.05:1 R:R); hard stop $1,158.45.

book_paragraphs: Before you invest a dollar—or commit three hours to studying a company—you deserve to know where the evidence lands. Over the chapters that follow, you and I will examine Eli Lilly from the inside out: first without looking at its stock price, and then by testing that business reality against today's $1,382.75 market price.

Here is our bottom line up front: Eli Lilly earns a Compounder Pass on business quality and a Pass on all six leading operational KPIs. Its incretin engine—Mounjaro, Zepbound, and newly approved oral GLP-1 Foundayo—drove Q3 2026 revenue up 39% to $24.40 billion and lifted full-year 2026 revenue guidance to $91.0–$92.0 billion, generating a 31.61% return on invested capital.

On the tape as of November 18, 2026, LLY sits in a confirmed Stage 2 uptrend just 6.70% above its 10-week EMA ($1,295.91), pulling back on light 0.95x volume while the broader S&P 500 trades in a Downtrend. Because the stock trades at 26.75x Forward P/E (0.79 PEG) against a $1,660.00 Base target (+20.05%), our New-Capital Verdict is Wait for Support (Tier 1, Core Alpha), holding 100% cash while waiting for a pullback into the $1,283.94–$1,323.04 support zone (2.05:1 R:R)—with a hard invalidation stop at $1,158.45. LLY is currently Not Held in your US accounts.

book_subsections.title: How to Use This Monograph
paragraphs: Chapters 1 through 6 were written under strict price-blind isolation—before we ever checked LLY's $1,382.75 share price or its 26.75x forward multiple—so that our judgment of Eli Lilly's moat, segment economics, manufacturing scale, and 10-year cash conversion could not be anchored by market sentiment. Chapters 7 through 9 then test that locked business reality against today's Reverse DCF expectations, peer multiples, Stage 2 technical structure, and portfolio-level capital allocation.

book_callouts.title: NARRATOR'S REFLECTION
book_callouts.text: The best institutional research separates business truth from stock-price noise. We graded Lilly's business before ever checking its $1,382.75 quote—and only when the Reverse DCF and Stage 2 tape confirmed 1.24:1 to 2.05:1 asymmetry did we earn the Wait for Support verdict.
